---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest an idea or improvement for the project.
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

# Issue Description
Please describe the feature you would like to see implemented in the project. Include any relevant details, screenshots, or examples that can help illustrate your idea.

# Motivation
Explain why this feature is important and how it would benefit the project or its users. What problem does it solve, or what improvement does it bring?

# Additional Context
Provide any additional context or information that may be helpful in understanding your feature request. Is this idea inspired by another project? Does it come from a known issue or limitation? Any relevant links or references are welcome.
